title: MR02 10-round AES-128 AES-to-BES conjugate embedding

target.description: Standard full10-round AES128 embedded in BES overGF(2^8), restricted to the AES conjugacy image BA. BES alone has a128-byte state, not the16-byte AES state.

setting.key_relation: One ordinary AES128 master key; embedded schedule must retain conjugacy and the actual AES key-schedule constraints.
setting.plaintext_model: AES16-byte plaintext/key and their conjugate embeddings; never arbitrary unrelated BES state/key vectors.

limitations: Result-level exclusion (BES only): Section5.2 uses arbitrary alternating scaled round subkeys, not the actual AES master-key schedule. For nonzero embedded states, scalar t outside{0,1} also breaks conjugacy; the trivial zero-state exception does not transfer the effect into an AES related-key attack.

property.statement: For each byte a, phi(a)=(a,a^2,a^4,...,a^128); componentwise embedding maps16 AES bytes into128 BES bytes. With pB=phi(pA),kB=phi(kA), the embedded key schedule and every round preserve BA and commute with phi: RoundB(phi(a),phi(ki))=phi(RoundA(a,ki)); the complete encryption commutes as well. Restriction to BA is essential.
property.quantifier: All source AES128 inputs and keys with correctly embedded subkeys; zero inversion follows the original cipher convention.
property.scope: Exact alternate representation of AES128; the larger unrestricted BES domain does not inherit AES security or establish an AES attack.

parameters.meaning: Additive and inverse-preserving vector conjugates; the complete10-round AES128 and schedule commute with the lifted maps.

validation.description: Complete exact16-page edition independently read before baseline comparison. Canonical finite checks cover the conjugate embedding, explicit128-dimensional linear operator, parity and count consistency; no full cryptanalytic search or solver executed.
